title: Industrial source commissioning, complete reconciliation and customer operation

task.name: Commission the selected industrial source and operate complete source-to-target reconciliation
task.purpose: Give the selected customer an editable, source-bound explanation of two complete industrial data editions: which observations agree, which differ under reviewed rules, which are absent, and which cannot yet be compared. Carry the original source, operating decisions and complete results into the customer's retained DuckDB workspace and named engineer's receiving environment.
task.request: Continue the original customer Workshare and Installation. Select one actual deployment and one useful comparison, its permitted source population, two immutable editions, source-use authority and receiving operator. Use the original Timescale commissioning report with its exact native text/NULL source tables, or the original local-source receiving path and its retained customer editions. Review every field and its type, identity, tag, time, value, quality, units and missing meaning before import. Preserve duplicate observations. Select the complete baseline and observed editions, explicit pairing fields, nonoverlapping windows and any literal maps. Apply only reviewed affine unit/time normalization and numeric tolerance. Inspect every source row, group, field comparison and conversion; resolve exceptions through retained engineer decisions. Save the complete report, native query exports and portable warehouse, then reopen the editable installation independently. Bind any paid acquisition to the original selected unit, price and authority.
task.completeOutput: Two complete original source editions and their retained source files; approved all-field import and pair reviews; original raw values, PostgreSQL OIDs where supplied, exact conversion/tolerance policies and arithmetic; balanced row accounting on both sides; full duplicate, one-sided, quarantined and outside-window populations; saved decisions and complete reports; every declared native export and a complete independently reopened editable warehouse. Include the source/merchant/customer configuration references, source and report histories, original requests, operating guide, release/source identities and named continuing operators.
task.repeatTrigger: The source owner supplies an actual later edition or the customer explicitly changes the population, mapping, canonical units/time, tolerance or decision policy. Preserve earlier editions, pair revisions, runs, reports and exports. Review the complete new scope before another run; compare retained findings and source changes. Opening, filtering, reporting or receiving an existing edition continues its original operation and does not imply another source acquisition.
task.pricedUnit: The separately agreed useful customer task or acquired complete source edition, as defined by the original merchant and customer agreement. Record actual per-request acquisition charges when that source needs several requests, and retain the aggregate task budget separately. The implementation Workshare fee and milestones remain in the original commercial workorder; they do not supply a native token price, purchase record or accepted funding.

source.reference: The customer's selected original Timescale commissioning report and exact report source tables, or complete retained local-source/customer editions received through the maintained Frictionless/SF100/DuckDB workflow. Record the actual report, workspace, source, import review, edition and pair identities. Operating sources are listed with their exact maintained file identities below.
source.population: Two complete selected editions of the agreed table/query/resource and comparison window, with original row counts, field order, source reference and completeness. Preserve all imported observations, including duplicates, NULLs, unmatched identities, unmapped values, invalid conversions and observations outside the selected windows. A restricted source, incomplete capture or intentionally limited query retains that exact scope; missing coverage remains explicit.
source.meaning: Retain every original field, raw text or typed value, explicit NULL and source row reference. Timescale input also retains ordered native column descriptors/OIDs and report context. Review tag/event identity, exact timestamps and timezone, value/quality meaning, units, schema changes and missingness. Pairing keys and window types are explicit. Literal maps distinguish NULL, empty text and unmapped values. Reviewed unit transforms and time interpretation retain the original representation beside exact canonical values and failure reasons. Numeric tolerance uses selected source/comparison units and complete exact differences; it never changes the retained observation or its source meaning.
source.changePolicy: Keep immutable source, import and pair editions. A changed source table, query, schema, selected row population, role, units, timezone, literal map or tolerance requires a new reviewed selection or pair revision. Record which changes affect comparability and the original report baseline. A finding absent from a later report is not automatically a corrected source record. The source owner authorizes any upstream correction or database change through the original operating process.

receiving.application: The existing Timescale commissioning desk and report exporter, original Timescale intake or Frictionless/local-dataset customer receiving, and the maintained paired reconciliation editor in the original DuckDB workspace. Compose the installed merchant/MCP/client/CLI and Applications entries from the selected source release. Use the native SF47 Customer installations desk for the complete source-bound implementation workorder and independent programme receiving.
receiving.acceptanceRule: Reopen the exact selected source report/files and both immutable customer editions. Confirm every field, role, type, raw/NULL value and complete selected population. Review the full pair and any normalization/tolerance policy before running. Both-side accounting must balance; duplicates, unmatched groups, conversions, quarantines and excluded windows must remain complete and traceable. Inspect raw and canonical values and exact differences, retain engineer decisions and their scope, and save the complete report with its immutable review/query binding. Download every declared export/package member and independently reopen the original editable warehouse and Installation. Record real operator observations against the original acceptance checks; planned inputs and generated workorders alone do not mark commissioning complete.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer and database/source owner retain source-use rights, production architecture, credentials, refresh/job approvals, access changes and withdrawal decisions. The implementation operator may perform only the explicitly authorized original source and commissioning actions. Retain superseded reports/editions under the agreed data-retention policy, update future access through the source owner's normal controls, and keep prior reports' original scope visible. Engineer exception decisions annotate the retained reconciliation; they do not mutate production source records.
receiving.recovery: Retain original request IDs, selected input bytes, source/report hashes, native status and completed results before follow-up reads. Inspect the original operation after interruption; continue the same request where supported rather than create a new capture, import, run or purchase. Keep the original Timescale report and its native source binding; do not manufacture SF88/SF100 delivery semantics for that format. Use the original complete package receiver, verify all declared bytes and reopen a separate editable working copy of the retained warehouse. Preserve the received original package and its receipt while legitimate later edits advance the working copy.
receiving.maintenance: Name the database/source owner, merchant and payment owner where applicable, customer analyst, production approver and receiving/support engineer. Retain exact release/configuration references, backup/restore and access renewal instructions, meaningful source cadence, full scope/change review, late-data or job/refresh responsibilities, monitoring, rollback and escalation. State the contracted correction/support allowance and ownership of vendor licenses, infrastructure and ongoing operations. Future deployments, additional sources or revised comparison semantics use the original change process and a newly selected scope.

steps.title: Continue the original customer Workshare
steps.result: Retain the complete commercial packet, original case and plan SHA, every phase, exact production effort, milestones, source rights and acceptance wording. Open the existing Installation or prepare its fresh source-bound seed. Keep customer deployment, source, payment and host selections explicit.

steps.title: Select the actual deployment and source contract
steps.result: Record source/target purpose, permitted connection or files, query/resource identity, complete population, table/OID or file schema, original edition references, operating authority, data sensitivity and production change owner. Separate unselected inputs from actual observed values.

steps.title: Commission or receive the original source
steps.result: For Timescale, use the original configured workspace, retained query editions and approved refresh/job/late-data actions, then export the complete immutable commissioning report. For local files, use the original descriptor/resource capture and retained dataset/customer path. Preserve every original file and its provenance; no substitute delivery receipt.

steps.title: Review all source fields and meanings
steps.result: Preview every page needed to understand both complete source editions. Select every original column exactly once, a lossless native type where justified, and explicit tag/time/value/quality meanings. Keep Timescale import keys empty so duplicate observations survive; choose comparison keys later in the pair.

steps.title: Import and retain both immutable editions
steps.result: Use the native reviewed import and verify review/edition/source bindings, full field order, row count and source manifests. Preserve the original source report, guide, raw files, descriptors and complete import result in the customer warehouse and whole handover.

steps.title: Review pairing and comparison scope
steps.result: Choose baseline and observed editions from their complete original catalogues. Map matching identities and comparison values, any reviewed literal map and exact nonoverlapping windows. Retain excluded/unmapped populations, duplicate multiplicity and the full pair review before saving a revision.

steps.title: Select exact unit and time normalization
steps.result: When needed, enter each explicit side/column conversion, native target type, units and source basis. Review complete both-side previews. Preserve original values and exact canonical results; quarantine overflow, unsupported precision, missing interpretation and failed conversions instead of rounding or guessing timezone.

steps.title: Select numeric acceptance rules
steps.result: For eligible non-key numeric comparison fields, explicitly choose absolute and/or relative tolerance, comparison unit and source basis. Keep decimal strings literal and relative tolerance within the native declared range. Preserve exact equality, within-tolerance, difference, NULL and non-comparable states separately with their full arithmetic.

steps.title: Run and inspect complete reconciliation
steps.result: Run the reviewed pair through the original engine. Reconcile both-side totals and inspect every group, field comparison, original row and conversion. Preserve duplicate groups and all quarantined, one-sided and outside-window observations; never select an arbitrary duplicate row to make a pair.

steps.title: Record engineer decisions and saved reports
steps.result: Record actual decision owner, reason, source reference and disposition on retained findings. Save the immutable report with its decision sequence, full review, source editions, saved query revisions and exact parameter text. Compare later reports using original scope and actual canonical value multiplicities.

steps.title: Export the whole customer operation
steps.result: Use original report/query exports and the complete portable package. Retain every declared manifest, query, request, execution, result, source and warehouse member with native lengths and digests. Preserve upstream source archives alongside the warehouse when the original receiving path stores them separately.

steps.title: Reopen independently and hand over ongoing work
steps.result: The named receiving engineer validates the full package, retains its original warehouse and creates an editable working copy. Reopen the same customer UUID, editions, pair revisions, runs, rules, decisions, reports and files through the installed application. Complete the agreed useful operator task, record actual receiving observations and hand over source cadence, recovery and support.

inputs: Complete original commercial Workshare commissioning source and matching receiving packet, original case/plan digest, every phase with exact numeric effort provenance, and current Installation edition if one exists
Actual selected customer deployment and use case, original source-use authority, source/target owners, production approvals and named receiving engineer

Complete immutable Timescale commissioning report with original native sources, or the original Frictionless/local-source archives and genuine received customer editions; exact report/source/row/field identities and completeness
Reviewed source/target field schedule covering all columns, native types/OIDs, stable row/tag/event/time keys, value/quality meaning, raw text/NULL/empty distinctions and source units
Two original immutable edition IDs, selected baseline/observed roles, exact comparison keys, literal maps, complete nonoverlapping windows and expected native view/query revisions

Explicit side/column affine unit and timestamp interpretation rules where required, canonical types and units, exact decimal parameters, timezone/source basis and reviewed conversion-failure treatment
Explicit eligible field tolerances with exact absolute/relative strings, comparison units and acceptance basis; no inherited implicit tolerance or silent input rounding

Selected accountable merchant and independent customer deployments and any original acquisition network/asset/recipient/atomic unit price, task budget, facilitator and authority; unselected values remain unselected

Original configuration/source release and private secret references, customer workspace/receiving host, complete package destination, retention/backup policy and actual source/merchant/customer operators
Agreed full report/exception review, two-edition acceptance, correction/support allowance, independent editable receiving task and subsequent source/change/maintenance procedure
